title: Unicode-Pfade und SSH-/FTP-Textgrenzen

client.scope: Only fresh local KVM4, SSH/SFTP/FTP actual protocol bytes, private directories and binary payloads; no benchmark/hardware probes.
client.case_policy: NTFS existing $UpCase; FAT ASCII case insensitive/nonASCII exact; no normalization

runtime.limits: Only real local KVM4/own private software disks and loopback SSH/SFTP/FTP. No host CPU-MSR-cache/native hardware/Windows/TCG/forced ISA. Config repeated hostfwd kept only last;3actual forwards verified/set through own QMP. Native1/2/3/4/5/6failures preserved; optional service status commands removed, actual code/target/stage checks retained. Binary upload client uses standard close-data/read-control, no EOF wait on upload. Existing NTFS UpCase/FAT ASCII and publication limits; no normalization/fullUnicode case folding or isolated transfer performance claim.

standard.limits: Exactly one final normal unchanged Suite3/all4, full original readback. Actual SSH/SFTP/FTP path/binary/negative tests are independent of STANDARD. All14 measured Spectra sources/references unchanged. Previous41 original retained. No native hardware/Windows acceptance or isolated FS-performance gain inferred. App/grapheme work remains43..44.

kernel_change: FAT create-only atomic publication rejects unsupported long target before durable claim/publish_started, so exact stage remains abortable; existing non-create long-target replacement preserved.
implementation: Published R4STD static path_text helper validates the entire shortest UTF8 scalar sequence, raw byte capacity, NUL/control/illegal characters and255UTF16unit components before operation/canonicalization; preserves original spaces and bytes, no normalization or inferred legacy/OEM mapping.

FTPSVC0.1.9: control-line overflow discarded through LF, embedded CR retained for rejection; UTF8 validation before dispatch, one command/path separator preserves further spaces. Exact OPTS UTF8/ON, explicit unsupported OFF/suffix. Complete names/listings and checked sends/reads;256entry listing cap returns failure. STOR claims data connection before150 so short/empty senders cannot close an unclaimed connection after positive readiness.

SSHD0.1.17: strict raw SFTP/SCP/exec paths, exact drive prefix, full SCP basename, full UTF8 SFTP names/long names and explicit response capacity errors. Config reads require exact registry data length, complete UTF8 and full destination capacity; invalid present paths/args reject startup without truncating defaults.

Kernel367 checks the existing FAT create-only short-target restriction before durable claim/publish_started. Unsupported Unicode long target returns not_atomic, keeps the exact stage abortable, and does not enter impossible settlement. Existing non-create replacement of an existing long target remains unchanged.

SSH channel queues remain byte streams; existing explicit text byte events are decoded at Terminal39. No channel-boundary decoding. NTFS existing $UpCase and FAT ASCII-only case folding retained; no normalization.

actual_protocol_client.scope: Only fresh local KVM4, SSH/SFTP/FTP actual protocol bytes, private directories and binary payloads; no benchmark/hardware probes.
actual_protocol_client.case_policy: NTFS existing $UpCase; FAT ASCII case insensitive/nonASCII exact; no normalization

unaccepted_attempts: Native6: deterministic unsupported FAT LFN publication entered publish_started and retained stage; original retained. Kernel preflight moved before claim/publication, no LFN-atomicity extension.
Native1: repeated readconfig hostfwd silently kept only last; stopped owned guest; original retained.
Native2: endpoints healthy, own QMP proves/fixes forwarding; host upload client incorrectly waited for EOF instead of closing data socket; retained.
Native3: full262161byte transfers pass;14byte upload exposed server150-before-accept race; fixed at FTP owner, no kernel TCP/lifetime change or client delay.

Native4/5: short/empty/max-name/NTFS/FAT roundtrips pass; optional hostclient status command used unsupported direct service launch then required an unavailable extra endpoint string. Removed optional status diagnostic; exact FTP reply/target/stage/payload assertions unchanged, originals retained.

boundaries: Only real local KVM4/software disks/loopback network. No Windows/native hardware/host CPU-MSR-cache/TCG/forced ISA acceptance.
UTF8 scalar filename subset; foreign unpaired UTF16/OEM names remain explicit unsupported filesystem cases from41. Existing NTFS $UpCase is not full Unicode case folding.

Existing FAT atomic long-name publication restrictions remain controlled errors with no wrong target/stage; no unsafe copy/delete atomicity claim. Full listing is bounded; oversized directories return failure.
SCP/config exact owner paths are host-tested; live cross-client proof is SSH exec/SFTP/FTP. Text scalar and glyph availability differ. App dialogs/graphemes follow43/44.
Exactly one final normal unchanged Suite3/all4 and original full readback. STANDARD does not isolate network/path performance; prior exports/seals retained.
